svg.title: A topic per thing
svg.desc: A new thing, such as an alarm, a contribution or a release, opens a topic of its own in the chat, named after its repository and what it is. Its message with the buttons comes first, and its changes edit it there. Its drafts, the answer of Fix, the prompt of Edit, what Later brings back and the answers to what Dennis asks in the topic follow in it; his question goes to the control repository together with the thing. Once the thing is done, its topic gets a check mark in front of its name and stays. When Dennis deletes the topic, the next message of the thing opens a new one, with the thing's own message first. Without Threaded Mode, or when Telegram refuses the topic or a message in it, the thing goes on in the main view, as before.
